entries.headline: Dethroned, but dangerous.
entries.commentary: Alpha One gave up the top spot after a bruising week, yet its duel fingerprint is the steadiest on the board. Count it out at your peril.

entries.headline: Beta takes the crown.
entries.commentary: A stunning reversal: Beta Two converted a mid-table slump into a three-day win streak and the league's best rating. The new benchmark.

entries.headline: Gone but not forgotten.
entries.commentary: Gamma Three retired before this snapshot, but its world-event consistency still haunts the mid-table.
